title: Vault of the Ember Crown
synopsis: The thing under the Wyrmscar was dreaming of a crown. Crowns have owners. This one has been under the Coldmarch for eight hundred years and has not stopped being one.

cast.name: Warden Hale
cast.about: Took the post because nobody else would sign for the Coldmarch. Signs for everything.

cast.name: Vessa of the Nine Coals
cast.about: Wants the crown worn, not owned, and does not much mind by whom.

cast.name: Durn Stonewake
cast.about: Has lost two columns on the vault road and intends to lose no more.

chapters.title: The Cold Road
chapters.intro: Hearthgate is the last holding with a bell, and it has been ringing for a week.

beats.speaker: hale
beats.title: Warden Hale
lines: "You came up the Ashen Road. Then you already know what we're arguing about."
"There's a vault out past the Wyrmscar line and it opened the same week your business down south ended. Something in it woke up when you closed that scar."
"Stonewake sent two columns. Stonewake is not sending a third."

journal: Warden Hale signed you onto the Coldmarch ledger, and handed over a lantern that casts no heat.
Two Stonewake columns went up the vault road. Neither came back, and neither is listed as dead.

quest.title: Put the Coldmarch Cairns back down

beats.speaker: durn
beats.title: Durn Stonewake, counting
lines: "Forty-one went up that road under my seal. I know where thirty-nine are. That is not a war record, it is an accounts problem, and I hate accounts problems."
"Take the column road. If you find the other two, they answer to me before they answer to any crown."

journal: Durn Stonewake opened the column road, on the condition that his missing two answer to him first.

chapters.title: Vault of the Ember Crown
chapters.intro: Past the last cairn the snow stops, in a perfect circle, and has for eight hundred years.

beats.speaker: vessa
beats.title: Vessa of the Nine Coals
lines: "You closed the scar. You have no idea what you woke, and I do, and I am still glad you did it."
"The crown wants a head. It does not especially care whose. Walk in with me and it will be worn by somebody who understands it."
"Or walk in without me, and it will be worn by whoever is left standing."

journal: You took the Nine Coals into the vault at your back.
You refused the Nine Coals. They are behind you on the vault road now.

quest.title: Take the Vault of the Ember Crown

beats.speaker: hale
beats.title: The ledger closes
lines: "The bell's stopped. First time since I took the post."
"I'm told there's a crown involved and I'm told not to ask. Fine. You're off the Coldmarch ledger, and the Coldmarch is off mine."

journal: The Ember Crown came out of the Coldmarch. What it does next is somebody's next problem.
